name: Leather Photo Keychain
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Best Material: Made of leather for the cover of chain and metal for the rest.
  • Multi-functional:
    • Personalization: The primary function of a photo keychain is to hold and display a personalized photo or image, allowing you to carry cherished memories wherever you go.
    • Portable Keepsake: A photo keychain serves as a portable keepsake, enabling you to carry a sentimental photo of loved ones, pets, or special moments with you at all times.
    • Accessory and Decor: Beyond its functionality, a photo keychain adds a decorative touch to your keys or bag, showcasing your personal style and preferences.
    • Durability: Most photo keychains are designed to be durable and long-lasting, protecting your cherished photos from wear and tear.
    • Convenience: Photo keychains are compact and lightweight, making them easy to carry without adding bulk to your belongings.
    • Customization: Many photo keychains allow you to change the photo whenever you like, giving you the flexibility to update the image.
    • Nostalgia: Carrying a photo keychain can evoke nostalgia and positive emotions every time you see the image.
    • Travel Companion: Your photo keychain can accompany you on your travels, serving as a small reminder of loved ones back home.
    • Promotional Item: Photo keychains can also be used as promotional items for businesses, displaying logos or images related to the brand.
  • Customization: Design will be printed on one side of the pot by our UV printed technology.
  • Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends. You can gift it to your favorite celebrities, friends, family members, lovers

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Keychain

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
